name: Init Gitea Test DB Role
description: TEST-ONLY. Runs in the postgres dependency container before gitea starts. Creates the passwordless `gitea` LOGIN role (mTLS cert CN) and hands the `gitea` database (created by production template 187) to it, so cert-only gitea livetest scenarios have a working owner role. Production proxvex creates NO database SQL; the operator does this (see json/applications/gitea/application.md, ## Database setup).
